findings.title: Dry runs can modify real files through copied symlinks
findings.description: `verbatimSymlinks` preserves links pointing outside the sandbox. For example, an absolute `.claude/rules` directory symlink remains connected to its real destination, and `InstallManifest.installFile()` follows it when writing rules. A preview can therefore update or prune real files. Reject escaping links or materialize isolated copies, and add symlink safety tests.

findings.title: Native worktree installation loses pruning containment guards
findings.description: Replacing the older-guide propagation path removes its lexical and realpath containment checks. The invoked `InstallManifest.finish()` joins manifest paths directly to the root and deletes checksum-matching files. A stale entry containing `../outside-file`, or traversing a symlinked directory, can delete outside the worktree. Restore containment validation before enabling this replacement.

findings.title: Sandbox paths produce false AGENTS.md changes
findings.description: The sandbox replaces `targetRoot`, but `scopedRuleIndex()` uses that root to calculate guide references. A normal agents install writes project-relative references; its dry run generates absolute references because the guide is outside the sandbox. Consequently, an unchanged installation reports `AGENTS.md` as modified. Preserve the logical destination root separately and test no-change previews for agents.

findings.title: Failed previews discard their diagnostic output
findings.description: The buffered output is replayed only after `install()` returns. Missing rule directories or broken managed markers print diagnostics to stdout and then throw `InstallAbort`; the replay is skipped, and `installIde()` returns failure without printing the exception. Replay failure diagnostics before propagating the abort, and assert their presence in the existing abort test.
